units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25b:16">R. Hash. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>לא תהא ש׳ גדולה מראייה</he> hearing (the statement of witnesses) ought not to be of greater legal value than seeing (if the judges themselves have seen the new phase of the moon).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:6">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>הולכין אחר שְׁמִיעַת בת קול</he> you may be guided by what you hear, considering it as a divine voice (it is not a divination practice to be forbidden).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:6">Ib.</cite> <he>נלך בתר שמיעת בת קול</he> let us be guided by what we shall hear.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:3">Cant. R. to II, 3</cite> <he>ישראל … הקדימו אמנה לש׳</he> the Israelites in Egypt advanced belief to hearing (<cite ref="Exodus 4:31">Ex. IV, 31</cite>); <he>בסיני … עשייה לש׳</he> at Sinai they advanced doing to hearing (ib. XXIV, 7; <cite ref="Shabbat 88a">Sabb. 88ᵃ</cite>, <cite ref="Gittin 7a:18">Gitt. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>נעשה לנשמע</he>).
<cite ref="Niddah 31a:29">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>שמיעת האוזן</he> the faculty of hearing; a. fr.
